meaning:
δια-γινώσκω
(see previous word), [in LXX chiefly for ידע, and cf. 2Ma.9:15 ;]
1. to distinguish, ascertain exactly: Act.23:15
2. As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, Act.24:22 (Cremer, 673).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case…
